description: Function body: an own-line `// comment` before `else`. S437 round 5 F1: round 4's dangling-else check rejected this valid shape (E-STMT-UNEXPECTED-TOKEN) because a COMMENT token sat between `}` and `else`; the else-lookahead after a BRACED consequent now skips comments (never a `;`). `@a` is true, so `r` must be 1 — an `else` running unconditionally would leave 2.
rationale: JS and scrml treat a comment between an `if` body's `}` and `else` as whitespace; only a `;` ends the `if` (S437 round 4 #4). §17: `else` belongs to the `if` whose body it follows.
